title: Optimal Investment to Reach a Financial Goal: A Stochastic Control Framework
abstract: arXiv:2610.10046v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We develop a framework for an investor who trades until she either reaches a financial goal or an exogenous deadline arrives. Analogous to utility functions over wealth, we measure satisfaction with the timing of reaching a goal by a discount function. For a continuous-time market where a stochastic factor drives the dynamics of stock prices and the financial goals, the investor maximizes the expected discount at the goal reaching time and the expected utility of the funding ratio if the goal remains unreached by the deadline. This setup leads to a new class of stochastic control problems. We establish Bellman's principle of optimality and characterize the value function as a viscosity solution to the associated Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equation. translated_title: 达成财务目标的最优投资：一个随机控制框架
translated_abstract: 我们为一种投资者构建了一个框架：该投资者持续交易，直到她达成财务目标或外生设定的截止期限到来。类似于以财富为自变量的效用函数，我们用一个折扣函数来衡量投资者对目标达成时点的满意度。在一个连续时间市场中，随机因子驱动股票价格和财务目标的动态变化，投资者最大化目标达成时刻的期望折扣值；若截止期限到来时目标仍未达成，则最大化资金比例的期望效用。这一设定引出了一类新的随机控制问题。我们建立了贝尔曼最优性原理，并将价值函数刻画为相应哈密顿-雅可比-贝尔曼（HJB）方程的黏性解。当截止期限为无穷且目标恒定时，HJB方程可化简为与倒向热方程相关的形式，对此我们给出了光滑解的完整刻画。
tldr: 本文提出一个新的随机控制框架，研究投资者在达成财务目标或截止期限到来之前的动态最优投资问题，用折扣函数刻画对目标达成时点的满意度，并证明价值函数是相应HJB方程的黏性解，在无限期限与恒定目标情形下给出光滑解的完整刻画。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a novel stochastic control framework for an investor who trades until reaching a financial goal or an exogenous deadline, measuring satisfaction via a discount function and characterizing the value function as a viscosity solution of the associated HJB equation, with a complete characterization of smooth solutions in the infinite-horizon, constant-goal case.
